data.narrative:
Perennial Autonomy is a Defense & Security stage company backed by Schmidt and staffed with talent from SpaceX, Google, and Apple. It has secured $500M in government contract value (IDIQ). The valuation universe for Defense & Security comprises 26 same-sector peers: 2 public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method is not applicable here. Despite 26 same-sector peers existing, the narrow filters for stage alignment, adjacent-stage positioning, and valuation-tier similarity yielded zero datapoints meeting the three-comparable minimum threshold. Falling back to an all-sector median would introduce material bias given the specialized nature of Defense & Security valuations and would not meaningfully reflect the target's risk and revenue profile.

Without sufficient narrowly-filtered peer data, traditional triangulation is constrained. A credible valuation range cannot be derived from the available data. To establish a defensible value, additional information is required: (1) revenue run-rate or contract conversion timing, (2) profitability or margin trajectory, (3) detailed financials from the identified private peers (Anduril, Helsing, et al.), and (4) comparable public comps' EV/revenue or EV/EBITDA multiples. The $500M IDIQ represents contract optionality but not recognized revenue, limiting its direct application to valuation.
